summary: Proved the rectangle cost-transfer bound for all two-level cluster metrics, giving a restricted observable O_p(log n) algorithm throughout p<1/2. Exact finite cluster and multiscale tests found no transfer failure; a small-side construction shows the deterministic kernel needs a linear r loss. General multiscale transfer and the immutable original remain unresolved. No candidate or manuscript; pass 1 recorded without changing runner counters.
next_test: Prove or falsify inequality (K) in evidence/research-pass1-rectangle-transfer.md for arbitrary ultrametrics with nonuniform order weights, arbitrary hierarchy depth/heights and unequal clusters. Seek a hierarchy charging invariant paying each order weight O_eta(r) times and the remainder to the exact ultrametric MST sum; a falsifier must have unbounded cost/[r(W+MST)] with verified rectangle density. A positive result still needs extension to general metrics.
